tutor_evidence.reduce: "Write critic A's ranks in critic B's order, so disagreements are out-of-order pairs."

tutor_evidence.count-while-merging: "when the right item is smaller than the left item, add the number of items left in the left half and move the right pointer" is the right counting rule, but it is never tied to merging the halves, and it is only correct when the halves are sorted.

hint: Here's a concrete way to spot loops. Give each town a pointer to another town in its group, and make one town in each group the leader, which points to itself. To check a cable, follow the pointers from both of its towns until you reach their leaders. If both lead to the same town, the cable would make a loop, so skip it. If not, lay the cable and point one leader at the other so the two groups become one. Next, work out how many cables you'll have laid when every town is connected, and how long the whole process takes.
